page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.large is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor platform. It features custom AWS Graviton ARM64 processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance provides 2 dedicated physical CPU cores and 2 vCPUs with 1 thread per core, accompanied by 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio characteristic of compute-heavy server profiles.

For storage and networking, c9gd.large comes equipped with 118 GB of attached local NVMe SSD instance storage. This direct-attached local storage delivers low latency and direct I/O performance suitable for scratch space or temporary operational data. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and operates without discrete GPU acceleration.

From a resource density perspective, c9gd.large offers an efficient balance of high-frequency Arm-based compute cores paired with fast local NVMe storage. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM configuration provides dedicated processing power without allocating excessive memory overhead. This instance is well matched for compute-intensive tasks, CI/CD build environments, web serving, and localized caching or database workloads that benefit from direct NVMe instance storage.
